body:
The stored-value audit left the exact BASIC browser task unqualified after a discarded harness sampled an empty transcript. Add a bounded verifier for the live Meet BASIC unit 2 machine and retain its usage instructions.

Eight live Chrome stages pass: ONE/ONE/TWO; wrong stored line 30; single-line repair; immediate wrong-name error and repair through canvas key events; RUN; fresh Restart; reset to the original maintained greeting. The check requires actual complete machine text, handles the tape loader header, distinguishes fresh reloads from stale output and rejects a missing repeated read. No lesson/runtime change or learner-effectiveness claim.

Evidence and failed harness attempts are retained in the companion docs PR: https://github.com/code198x/docs/pull/81 . Exact historical cause remains unknown because the discarded source was not retained. Validation: live Chrome 155.0.8059.40 at 1440×1000, eight stages, actual canvas screenshots inspected, 14 served JS/WASM response identities, node --check, Acorn zero inserted semicolons and git diff --check. No fresh build or broader device/accessibility/latency qualification is claimed.

Fixes #747 when the companion evidence is accepted. Parent umbrellas #115/#124 remain open.
title: Qualify embedded BASIC stored values and error recovery
